WU_2017_p166__paragraph_1.ocr:
___________
(a)  
Constant currency revenue growth assumes that revenues denominated in foreign currencies are translated to the United 
States dollar, net of the effect of foreign currency hedges, at rates consistent with those in the prior year.
(b) 
Westernunion.com revenues have also been included in each region, as described earlier.

Westernunion.com, which is included in the regional percentages above, represented approximately 10%, 8%, and 6% of our 
Consumer-to-Consumer revenue for the years ended December 31, 2017, 2016, and 2015, respectively.

WU_2017_p166__paragraph_3.ocr:
Our consumers transferred $81.8 billion, $80.0 billion, and $81.6 billion in Consumer-to-Consumer principal for the years 
ended December 31, 2017, 2016, and 2015, respectively, of which $74.5 billion, $72.5 billion, and $73.6 billion, respectively, 
related to cross-border principal, for the same corresponding periods described above.
